title: Weak Are the Seeker and the Sought
subtitle: The fly in Surah Al-Hajj (22:73)

content.alt: Weak Are the Seeker and the Sought

content.text: Allah gives an example in Surah Al-Hajj (22:73) and asks us to listen:

content.alt: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوا لَهُ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ الذُّبَابُ شَيْئًا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ (Qur'an 22:73)

content.text: "People, here is an example, so listen to it. Those you call on besides Allah could never create a fly, even if they all came together to do it. And if the fly snatched something from them, they could not get it back. Weak are the seeker and the sought."
"Weak are the seeker and the sought": ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ. The idol is weak, and so is the one who runs after it.

The same is true of everything we chase in place of Allah. Money, status, the next gadget, the next promotion. Once we have it, the shine fades and we are off chasing something else. There is no end to it, and both the chaser and the thing chased stay weak.
Seek the One who is truly strong, your Creator. That is what makes a person strong, and content.
